about.title: About
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Bilal, a full-stack software engineer motivated by technical challenges and passionate about innovation[cite: 1]. My focus is on designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable web and mobile applications[cite: 1].

I graduated from ENSA Fès with a degree in Computer Engineering[cite: 1]. Since then, I've had the chance to work across agritech, enterprise software, and national banking contexts[cite: 1]. My main focus these days is building national TPE/PME scoring services and modernizing central platforms at Bank Al-Maghrib[cite: 1].
I continuously explore new tools and methods, particularly in microservices architectures and AI automation with tools like GitHub Copilot, RAG, and LLMs[cite: 1].
